proposed_comments.title: Keep asynchronous WinMM sound buffers pinned
proposed_comments.body: The `SND_MEMORY | SND_ASYNC` call passes a managed `byte[]` through P/Invoke, but asynchronous WinMM playback can continue after the call returns. The array must remain at a stable address for the full playback lifetime; retaining it in `Lazy<byte[]>` does not pin it. Pin each sound buffer for the duration of async playback, or use a filename-based playback path that does not depend on a movable managed buffer. Update the matching `PlaySound` declaration in `NativeMethods.cs` and verify both opening and closing playback after forced GC activity.

confidence.rationale: Asynchronous native playback can retain the buffer pointer after the managed call returns; the validated fork pins the buffers.

proposed_comments.title: Update metadata on the existing WAV SDK items
proposed_comments.body:
Use SDK item metadata updates for these existing WAV files so the project does not create duplicate `None` items.

```suggestion
<None Update="Sounds\open.wav">
  <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
</None>
<None Update="Sounds\close.wav">
  <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
</None>
```

confidence.rationale: The files already participate in SDK default items; Update changes metadata without duplicating them.

proposed_comments.title: Assert the compatibility defaults explicitly

confidence.rationale: Comparing two views of the same mutable state cannot protect the intended false/true/true compatibility contract.

proposed_comments.title: Exercise sound settings away from their defaults

confidence.rationale: The current test does not execute the opening-sound mutation path; the candidate verifies all three callbacks.

proposed_comments.title: Use a non-default opening-sound value in the CLI test
proposed_comments.body:
Set the opening-sound test value to `false`, because the live default is `true`. Using the default value does not exercise the command's mutation path.

```suggestion
[DataRow(typeof(PowerLauncherSettings), nameof(PowerLauncherProperties.EnableOpeningSound), "false")]
```

confidence.rationale: A default-to-default assignment cannot prove that the CLI command persists a changed setting.
